items.says: Experience appears after Education, so the resume does not establish the candidate’s research and market direction before the academic background.
The line attributes the entire increase in the desk book’s Sharpe ratio from 1.1 to 1.5 to the signal without showing that the signal caused the full improvement.
The method behind the 'cost-aware position smoother' is too compressed for a quant reader to assess.
Purged walk-forward splits and an embargo period cannot support the claim that every backtest decision used only information available at the time.
The feature store’s stated outcome is limited to reuse in two later signal projects, without showing what that reuse improved.
The line does not state the capacity estimate or the scale of the 'small live allocation.'
The onboarding outcome is delayed until the final clause instead of leading the bullet.
The claim that every run was reproducible from its seed and configuration file overstates what those two artifacts alone can guarantee.
The claimed logarithmic-factor improvement to the previous variance bound is not established with enough detail to verify the comparison.
The line describes writing and presenting a working paper but does not state what the communication achieved.
The line gives both '41st of 2,900 teams' and 'top 2%,' which communicate nearly the same ranking information.
The line gives a 0.02 gap between local validation and leaderboard scores without identifying the score metric or making clear how the gap changed.
The phrase 'without losing validation score' does not identify which validation metric was preserved or whether it remained identical or merely comparable.
